title: Lamb Skewers with Mediterranean Flair
description: A flavorful and colorful dish featuring marinated lamb skewers grilled to perfection, served with a side of fresh Mediterranean herbs.

ingredients.name: Lamb shoulder, cut into 1-inch cubes
ingredients.notes: preferably with some fat for flavor

instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together olive oil, lemon juice, garlic, yogurt, oregano, salt, and pepper to make the marinade.
Add the lamb cubes to the marinade and toss to coat evenly.
Cover the bowl with plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least 2 hours or overnight.
Preheat the grill to medium-high heat (about 400°F/200°C).
Thread the marinated lamb cubes onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Grill the skewers for 8-10 minutes per side, or until cooked to your desired level of doneness.
Transfer the skewers to a plate and let rest for 5 minutes before serving.
Serve immediately, garnished with additional oregano and lemon wedges if desired.
